pre_existing_course.course: Japanese affection and register - an L0 demonstration classroom
pre_existing_course.view_note: This lesson was authored before the block document existed, so it has no short-text or sequenced view. Textbook view only.

block_shorts: お願いします (onegaishimasu) for a request; ありがとうございます (arigatou gozaimasu) for thanks.
Standard polite forms are the safe default in a shop; casual forms belong with friends.
Repeat お願いします with romaji visible, then once more without it.
Wait for the staff member to respond, then thank them with ありがとうございます.
Pick the phrase that fits entering a shop and speaking to staff for the first time.
